text:
Marta: Hey team — quick sync. We recorded the Lighthouse product-usage interview yesterday and want to ship a short case post + transcript + localized clips. Embargo target: 2026-04-14. Who can own transcription + vendor handoff?
Dennis: I can spin up the transcription job today. will need final audio file and preferred S3 path.
Marta: Audio uploaded: s3://redwood-marketing/lighthouse/lighthouse_interview_2026-03-18.wav
Anjali: I can do localization coordination. LingoWorks (our vendor) available for DE/FR/JP next week. Need the clean transcript and timecodes.
Tom: Can you add speaker labels? we have two speakers (Customer / Host). important for pull quotes.
Dennis: will request speaker diarization output. I’ll output:
```
transcript.v1.txt (raw, with timecodes)
transcript.clean.v1.txt (no ums/ahs)
transcript.srt (for clips)
```
Marta: perfect. Also need two short pull quotes cleared by legal for the post. Maya, can you triage?
Maya (Legal): shared the snippet guideline doc. quick check: send proposed quotes as bullet points and call out any customer names/org-sensitive lines. I can review within 48 hrs.
Marta: cool — proposed bullets (first pass):
- "Lighthouse halved our inference costs in prod within 2 months"
- "Switching to Redwood made latency predictable across regions"
Maya (Legal): ok hold — "halved" is a strong claim. need metric source (KPI dashboard snapshot) or change wording to "reduced by ~50%" and approval from the customer.
Anjali: will flag for localization: avoid numeric idioms in translations. use neutral phrasing first, then localize.
Dennis: transcription job kicked off — ETA ~2h. I’ll upload artifacts to s3://redwood-marketing/lighthouse/deliverables/ and @Marta will get notified by PublishBot when ready.
PublishBot: Transcription complete — files: transcript.clean.v1.txt, transcript.srt uploaded to s3://redwood-marketing/lighthouse/deliverables/ at 2026-03-18T16:02:15Z :white_check_mark:
Marta: moving to quote clearance: Anjali please send the two quote options to the customer for signoff (include exact punctuation). keep one conservative fallback.
Anjali: pinged customer via email and shared a translated-friendly version. requested signoff by 2026-03-20 EOD.
Maya (Legal): once customer signs, I’ll run a final redline pass. if we need anonymized metrics, we’ll use the dashboard screenshot with a masked ID.
LingoWorks: confirmed localization slots for 03/22 - will need final transcript and glossary (brand terms).
Tom: timeline check — localization + legal + asset build = on track for 04-14 embargo if approvals come back by 03-20. backward schedule attached.
Marta: thanks. next actions: Dennis confirm S3 path & speaker-labeled transcript (today), Anjali follow localization & customer quote signoff, Maya final legal review after signoff. I’ll compile launch brief and draft the blog/headline once quotes confirmed.
Dennis: done, speaker labels included and file paths posted.
Marta: awesome — will update the launch doc and drop a preview in #marketing when we have legal thumbs up. :sparkles:
Tom: small ask — can we also export a 60s highlight clip with captions for social? if yes, add `highlight_60s.mp4` to the asset list.
Marta: added to the asset list. Dennis, can you generate the srt-based captions for the 60s cut?
Dennis: yes. I’ll cut the clip and attach captioned mp4 to the deliverables folder when ready.
PublishBot: Asset `lighthouse_highlight_60s.mp4` uploaded to s3://redwood-marketing/lighthouse/deliverables/ at 2026-03-19T09:12:03Z
Maya (Legal): received customer signoff on the conservative quote. legal pass complete — minor grammar redlines only.
Marta: excellent. locking embargo 2026-04-14. thanks everyone! :tada:
